angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 964,936 km at 118.43 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.4436 +/- 0.0186 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 118.43 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.387 +/- 0.08 solar radii from Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5806 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract): 964,936 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.333 +/- 0.099 solar masses from Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5806 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6730 +/- 190 K from Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5806 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5806 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5806.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.279, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5806 (pscomppars): spectral type F3 V, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5806 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.019 dex, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5806 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.54986, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1780750207505594496, flags_flame 00: age_flame 2.3407795 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 1.8742478 to 2.7919466)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5806 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 19.072 km/s, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
